example.zh: 严冬的清晨寒气逼人，环卫工人常常对着冻僵的双手呵一口热气。
example.py: Yándōng de qīngchén hánqì bīrén, huánwèi gōngrén chángcháng duìzhe dòngjiāng de shuāngshǒu hē yì kǒu rèqì.
example.en: On freezing winter mornings when the chill was biting, sanitation workers often exhaled a breath of warm air onto their numb hands.

meaning: to suffer, to endure; to get (criticized, scolded, beaten)

example.zh: 他因为上班迟到挨了经理的批评。
example.py: Tā yīnwèi shàngbān chídào ái le jīnglǐ de pīpíng.
example.en: He got criticized by the manager for being late to work.

meaning: to love sth too much to part with it (idiom)

example.zh: 他对这本精美的摄影集喜爱至极，简直爱不释手。
example.py: Tā duì zhè běn jīngměi de shèyǐngjí xǐ'ài zhìjí, jiǎnzhí ài bù shì shǒu.
example.en: He loved this exquisite photography album so much that he couldn't bear to put it down.

meaning: to love and respect; love and respect

example.zh: 这位老教授不仅学术造诣深厚，而且关怀爱护学生，赢得了全校师生的衷心爱戴。
example.py: Zhè wèi lǎo jiàoshòu bùjǐn xuéshù zàoyì shēnhòu, érqiě guānhuái àihù xuéshēng, yíngdé le quán xiào shīshēng de zhōngxīn àidài.
example.en: This veteran professor not only possesses profound academic attainments but also cares deeply for his students, winning the heartfelt love and esteem of teachers and students across the university.

example.zh: 他们的关系有些暧昧。
example.py: tāmen de guānxi yǒuxiē àimèi 。
example.en: Their relationship is somewhat ambiguous.

meaning: hey; ow; ouch; interjection of pain or surprise

example.zh: “哎哟，我的脚踝扭到了，疼得站不起来！”他痛苦地叫道。
example.py: "Āiyō, wǒ de jiǎohuái niǔ dào le, téng de zhàn bù qǐlái!" tā tòngkǔ de jiàodào.
example.en: "Ouch, I twisted my ankle, it hurts so much I can't stand up!" he cried in pain.

example.zh: 他儿子小时候就死于癌症了。
example.py: tā érzi xiǎoshíhou jiù sǐ yú áizhèng le 。
example.en: His son died of cancer a child.

example.zh: 尽管这种药物价格昂贵,只要疗效显著,仍然值得纳入公共医疗保障的讨论。
example.py: Jǐnguǎn zhè zhǒng yàowù jiàgé ángguì, zhǐyào liáoxiào xiǎnzhù, réngrán zhíde nàrù gōnggòng yīliáo bǎozhàng de tǎolùn.
example.en: Although this medicine is expensive, if its effects are significant, it is still worth discussing whether to include it in public medical coverage.

example.zh: 这个案件可能不会在短时间内就解决。
example.py: zhège ànjiàn kěnéng bùhuì zài duǎnshíjiān nèi jiù jiějué 。
example.en: The case may not be solved in a short time.

meaning: to live in peace and work happily (idiom)

example.zh: 国家繁荣昌盛，人民才能安居乐业。
example.py: Guójiā fánróng chāngshèng, rénmín cáinéng ānjū-lèyè.
example.en: Only when the country is prosperous can the people live in peace and work happily.

example.zh: 这个案例说明,企业在追求效率的同时不能忽视员工的基本权益。
example.py: Zhège ànlì shuōmíng, qǐyè zài zhuīqiú xiàolǜ de tóngshí bù néng hūshì yuángōng de jīběn quányì.
example.en: This case shows that, while pursuing efficiency, companies must not ignore employees’ basic rights and interests.

example.zh: 长时间盯着屏幕后,他请理疗师按摩肩颈,缓解僵硬和疼痛。
example.py: Cháng shíjiān dīngzhe píngmù hòu, tā qǐng lǐliáoshī ànmó jiānjǐng, huǎnjiě jiāngyìng hé téngtòng.
example.en: After staring at a screen for a long time, he asked a physiotherapist to massage his neck and shoulders to ease stiffness and pain.

meaning: Anning District of Lanzhou City 兰州市, Gansu; Anning City, to the west of Kunming 明, Yunnan; peaceful; tranquil; calm; composed; free from worry

example.zh: 让我们享受这平静和安宁。
example.py: ràng wǒmen xiǎngshòu zhè píngjìng hé ānníng 。
example.en: Let us enjoy the peace and quiet.

example.zh: 他没有直接拒绝,却用沉默暗示自己并不赞成这个方案。
example.py: Tā méiyǒu zhíjiē jùjué, què yòng chénmò ànshì zìjǐ bìng bú zànchéng zhège fāng'àn.
example.en: He did not refuse directly, but used silence to imply that he did not actually support the proposal.

example.zh: 老艺术家安详地坐在公园长椅上，静静聆听着树枝间清脆的鸟鸣。
example.py: Lǎo yìshùjiā ānxiáng de zuò zài gōngyuán chángyǐ shang, jìngjìng língtīng zhe shùzhī jiān qīngcuì de niǎomíng.
example.en: The elderly artist sat serenely on the park bench, quietly listening to the crisp birdsong among the branches.

meaning: to find a place for; to help settle down; to arrange for; to get into bed; placement

example.zh: 把家具安置好。
example.py: bǎ jiā jù ān zhì hǎo
example.en: Arrange the furniture properly.

meaning: to boil; to simmer; to cook on a slow fire; to extract by heating; to decoct; to endure

example.zh: 面对创业初期的重重艰辛，团队咬紧牙关，终于熬过了资金匮乏的困境。
example.py: Miànduì chuàngyè chūqī de zhòngzhòng jiānxīn, tuánduì yǎojǐn yáguān, zhōngyú áoguò le zījīn kuìfá de kùnjìng.
example.en: Facing manifold hardships in the early stages of entrepreneurship, the team gritted their teeth and finally endured through the predicament of capital shortage.

example.zh: 天体物理学家借助深空探测望远镜，一步步揭开黑洞形成的奥秘。
example.py: Tiāntǐ wùlǐ xuéjiā jièzhù shēnkōng tàncè wàngyuǎnjìng, yíbùbù jiēkāi hēidòng xíngchéng de àomì.
example.en: With the help of deep-space exploration telescopes, astrophysicists are unraveling step by step the mysteries of black hole formation.

meaning: concave or convex; bumps and holes; uneven (surface); rugged

example.zh: 越野车在凹凸不平的山间碎石路上颠簸前行，车速十分缓慢。
example.py: Yuèyěchē zài āotū-bùpíng de shānjiān suìshílù shang diānbǒ qiánxíng, chēsù shífēn huǎnmàn.
example.en: The off-road vehicle bumped along the uneven gravel road in the mountains at a very slow pace.

meaning: to peel; to skin; to tear; to pull down; to cling to (sth on which one is climbing); to dig; to rake up; to steal; to braise; to crawl

example.zh: 厨师利落地把烤熟的板栗外壳扒开，露出里面金黄香甜的果肉。
example.py: Chúshī lìluo de bǎ kǎoshú de bǎnlì wàiké bā kāi, lùchū lǐmiàn jīnhuáng xiāngtián de guǒròu.
example.en: The chef deftly peeled open the shells of the roasted chestnuts, revealing the golden, sweet nuts inside.

example.zh: 尽管手术后留下了一道浅浅的疤，但他的身体已经完全康复了。
example.py: Jǐnguǎn shǒushù hòu liúxià le yí dào qiǎnqiǎn de bā, dàn tā de shēntǐ yǐjīng wánquán kāngfù le.
example.en: Although a faint scar was left after the surgery, he has made a full recovery.

meaning: (coll.) to be eager for; to long for; to look forward to

example.zh: 经过连续几个月的加班，他巴不得立刻休假去海边放松几天。
example.py: Jīngguò liánxù jǐ ge yuè de jiābān, tā bā bu de lìkè xiūjià qù hǎibiān fàngsōng jǐ tiān.
example.en: After months of continuous overtime, he can hardly wait to take some time off and relax by the sea.

meaning: the Way of the Hegemon; abbr. for 霸王之道; despotic rule; rule by might; evil as opposed to the Way of the King 王道; overbearing; tyranny; (of liquor, medicine etc) strong; potent

example.zh: 他在团队讨论中态度非常霸道，从不给其他人表达意见的机会。
example.py: Tā zài tuánduì tǎolùn zhōng tàidù fēicháng bàdào, cóngbù gěi qítā rén biǎodá yìjiàn de jīhuì.
example.en: His attitude during team discussions was very domineering, never giving others a chance to voice their opinions.

meaning: a strike; to go on strike

example.zh: 工人罢工了。
example.py: gōng rén bà gōng le
example.en: Workers went on strike.

meaning: to check on sth; to guard a pass; quality control

example.zh: 技术总监亲自为新产品的每一个环节把关。
example.py: Jìshù zǒngjiān qīnzì wèi xīn chǎnpǐn de měi yí ge huánjié bǎguān.
example.en: The technical director personally checks every stage of the new product.

meaning: to break off or break open sth with one's hands; (fig.) to break off (a relationship)

example.zh: 奶奶把刚蒸好的玉米掰成两半，递给了身旁的孩子。
example.py: Nǎinai bǎ gāng zhēng hǎo de yùmǐ bāi chéng liǎng bàn, dì gěi le shēnpáng de háizi.
example.en: Grandma broke the freshly steamed corn in half and handed it to the child beside her.

example.zh: 到达北京后,他第一件事不是参加会议,而是拜访曾经指导过他的老教授。
example.py: Dàodá Běijīng hòu, tā dì yī jiàn shì bú shì cānjiā huìyì, ér shì bàifǎng céngjīng zhǐdǎo guò tā de lǎo jiàoshòu.
example.en: After arriving in Beijing, the first thing he did was not attend the meeting, but visit the old professor who had once guided him.

example.zh: 失业率上升了两个百分点,但不同地区受到的影响并不相同。
example.py: Shīyèlǜ shàngshēng le liǎng gè bǎifēndiǎn, dàn bùtóng dìqū shòudào de yǐngxiǎng bìng bù xiāngtóng.
example.en: The unemployment rate rose by two percentage points, but different regions were not affected in the same way.

meaning: to ruin; to corrupt; to undermine

example.zh: 这种弄虚作假的行为严重败坏了公司的商业信誉。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng nòngxū-zuòjiǎ de xíngwéi yánzhòng bàihuài le gōngsī de shāngyè xìnyù.
example.en: Such fraudulent behavior has severely damaged the company's commercial reputation.

meaning: to pay a New Year’s visit

example.zh: 春节期间,很多年轻人选择通过视频拜年,以减少长途奔波。
example.py: Chūnjié qījiān, hěn duō niánqīng rén xuǎnzé tōngguò shìpín bàinián, yǐ jiǎnshǎo chángtú bēnbō.
example.en: During the Spring Festival, many young people choose to send New Year greetings by video to reduce long-distance travel.

meaning: to request sb to do sth; please!

example.zh: 拜托您，请给我一张签证。
example.py: bàituō nín ， qǐng gěi wǒ yīzhāng qiānzhèng 。
example.en: Come on you, please give me a visa.

meaning: to get rid of, to break away from

example.zh: 他终于摆脱了对父母意见的过度依赖,开始独立规划自己的职业道路。
example.py: Tā zhōngyú bǎituō le duì fùmǔ yìjiàn de guòdù yīlài, kāishǐ dúlì guīhuà zìjǐ de zhíyè dàolù.
example.en: He finally broke away from relying too heavily on his parents’ opinions and began planning his own career path independently.

meaning: to fawn on; to curry favor with; to make up to

example.zh: 他为人正直，向来不屑于通过巴结领导来获得升迁。
example.py: Tā wéirén zhèngzhí, xiànglái bùxiè yú tōngguò bājie lǐngdǎo lái huòdé shēngqiān.
example.en: He is an upright person who has always disdained currying favor with leaders to get a promotion.

meaning: to spoil things through excessive enthusiasm (idiom)

example.zh: 教育孩子要循序渐进，千万不能拔苗助长。
example.py: Jiàoyù háizi yào xúnxù-jiànjìn, qiānwàn bùnéng bámiáo-zhùzhǎng.
example.en: Educating children requires gradual progress; one must never rush things and ruin them.

example.zh: 不同版本的合同条款略有差异,签字前必须逐项核对。
example.py: Bùtóng bǎnběn de hétong tiáokuǎn lüèyǒu chāyì, qiānzì qián bìxū zhúxiàng héduì.
example.en: The terms in different versions of the contract vary slightly, so each item must be checked before signing.

meaning: to issue; to proclaim; to enact (laws, decrees etc)

example.zh: 政府近期颁布了一系列支持新能源产业发展的新政策。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ jìnqī bānbù le yí xìliè zhīchí xīn néngyuán chǎnyè fāzhǎn de xīn zhèngcè.
example.en: The government recently promulgated a series of new policies supporting the development of the new energy industry.

meaning: to issue; to promulgate; to award

example.zh: 另外，之后我们会颁发“每月最佳员工”奖。
example.py: lìngwài ， zhīhòu wǒmen huì bānfā “ měiyuè zuìjiā yuángōng ” jiǎng 。
example.en: In addition, we will be awarded after the "Monthly Employee" award.

meaning: scale (instrument for weighing); to weigh; (loanword) pound (unit of weight, about 454 grams); (printing) point (unit used to measure the size of type)

example.zh: 这件托运行李重约五十磅，刚好符合航空公司的免费托运标准。
example.py: Zhè jiàn tuōyùn xíngli zhòng yuē wǔshí bàng, gānghǎo fúhé hángkōng gōngsī de miǎnfèi tuōyùn biāozhǔn.
example.en: This checked baggage weighs about fifty pounds, just meeting the airline's free allowance limit.

meaning: to kidnap; to abduct; to hijack; a kidnapping; abduction; staking

example.zh: 警方经过周密侦查，成功解救了被绑架的人质并抓获了嫌疑人。
example.py: Jǐngfāng jīngguò zhōumì zhēnchá, chénggōng jiějiù le bèi bǎngjià de rénzhì bìng zhuāhuò le xiányírén.
example.en: Following a thorough investigation, the police successfully rescued the kidnapped hostage and arrested the suspect.

example.zh: 对许多基层员工来说,主管的一言一行都可能成为榜样或反面教材。
example.py: Duì xǔduō jīcéng yuángōng lái shuō, zhǔguǎn de yì yán yì xíng dōu kěnéng chéngwéi bǎngyàng huò fǎnmiàn jiàocái.
example.en: For many front-line employees, a manager’s every word and action may become either a model to follow or a negative example.

example.zh: 他的狗是他的好伴侣。
example.py: tā de gǒu shì tā de hǎobànlǚ 。
example.en: His dog is his good mate.

example.zh: 经济快速增长往往伴随着资源消耗增加和社会结构变化。
example.py: Jīngjì kuàisù zēngzhǎng wǎngwǎng bànsuí zhe zīyuán xiāohào zēngjiā hé shèhuì jiégòu biànhuà.
example.en: Rapid economic growth is often accompanied by increased resource consumption and changes in social structure.

meaning: to give up halfway; to leave unfinished (idiom)

example.zh: 做事情最忌讳半途而废，坚持到底才能迎来成功。
example.py: Zuò shìqing zuì jìhuì bàntú'érfèi, jiānchí dàodǐ cáinéng yínglái chénggōng.
example.en: The worst thing is giving up halfway; only persisting to the end brings success.

example.zh: 斑马身上独特的黑白斑纹能够有效迷惑捕食者的视线。
example.py: Bānmǎ shēnshang dútè de hēibái bānwén nénggòu yǒuxiào míhuo bǔshízhě de shìxiàn.
example.en: The unique black-and-white stripes on a zebra can effectively confuse the vision of predators.

meaning: to play the role of, to act as

example.zh: 在这场谈判中,第三方机构扮演了调解者的角色,使僵局逐渐缓和。
example.py: Zài zhè chǎng tánpàn zhōng, dì sānfāng jīgòu bànyǎn le tiáojiě zhě de juésè, shǐ jiāngjú zhújiàn huǎnhé.
example.en: In this negotiation, the third-party organisation acted as a mediator, gradually easing the deadlock.

meaning: to shield; to harbor; to cover up

example.zh: 无论职位多高，任何包庇违法犯罪分子的行为都必将受到法律严惩。
example.py: Wúlùn zhíwèi duō gāo, rènhé bāobì wéifǎ fànzuì fènzǐ de xíngwéi dōu bìjiāng shòudào fǎlǜ yánchěng.
example.en: No matter how high one's rank, any act of harboring criminals will surely be severely punished by law.

example.zh: 你杀了我父亲，我今天要为他报仇。
example.py: nǐ shā le wǒ fùqīn ， wǒ jīntiān yào wéi tā bàochóu 。
example.en: You killed my father, today I want to take revenge for him.

example.zh: 让我们平分这个报酬吧。
example.py: ràng wǒmen píngfēn zhège bàochóu ba 。
example.en: Let's split the reward of this right.

example.zh: 他报答了老师的关怀。
example.py: tā bào dá le lǎo shī de guān huái
example.en: He repaid the teacher's care.

meaning: to report for duty, to check in

example.zh: 新同学已经去学校报到了。
example.py: xīn tóng xué yǐ jīng qù xué xiào bào dào liǎo 。
example.en: The new students have already registered at the school.

example.zh: 谈判破裂后,边境地区再次爆发冲突,数千名居民被迫撤离。
example.py: Tánpàn pòliè hòu, biānjìng dìqū zàicì bàofā chōngtū, shù qiān míng jūmín bèipò chèlí.
example.en: After the negotiations broke down, conflict broke out again in the border region, forcing thousands of residents to evacuate.

meaning: wrapping cloth; a bundle wrapped in cloth; load; weight; burden; funny part; punchline

example.zh: 我们要放下沉重的思想包袱，以积极的心态迎接新的挑战。
example.py: Wǒmen yào fàngxià chénzhòng de sīxiǎng bāofu, yǐ jījí de xīntài yíngjiē xīn de tiǎozhàn.
example.en: We need to shed our heavy mental baggage and embrace new challenges with a positive mindset.

meaning: to make reprisals; to retaliate; revenge; retaliation

example.zh: 面对竞争对手的恶意攻击，他选择依法维权，而不是采取报复手段。
example.py: Miànduì jìngzhēng duìshǒu de èyì gōngjī, tā xuǎnzé yīfǎ wéiquán, ér bú shì cǎiqǔ bàofù shǒuduàn.
example.en: Faced with malicious attacks from a competitor, he chose to defend his rights legally rather than resort to retaliation.

example.zh: 他有抱负，所以他很努力工作。
example.py: tā yǒu bàofù ， suǒyǐ tā hěn nǔlì gōngzuò 。
example.en: He has ambition, so he worked very hard work.

meaning: to take care of, to keep

example.zh: 这份合同涉及商业机密,请由法务部统一保管,不要随意复印或转发。
example.py: Zhè fèn hétong shèjí shāngyè jīmì, qǐng yóu fǎwùbù tǒngyī bǎoguǎn, bú yào suíyì fùyìn huò zhuǎnfā.
example.en: This contract involves commercial secrets, so please have the legal department keep it centrally and do not copy or forward it casually.

meaning: to expose (photography); (fig.) to expose (a scandal); (advertising) exposure; Taiwan pr. [pù guāng]

example.zh: 这家餐厅的卫生问题被媒体曝光后，相关部门立即介入调查并责令整改。
example.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng de wèishēng wèntí bèi méitǐ bàoguāng hòu, xiāngguān bùmén lìjí jièrù diàochá bìng zélìng zhěnggǎi.
example.en: After the restaurant's hygiene issues were exposed by the media, relevant departments immediately launched an investigation and ordered rectifications.

example.zh: 本地手机市场已经趋于饱和，厂商必须开拓海外新兴市场来寻求增长。
example.py: Běndì shǒujī shìchǎng yǐjīng qūyú bǎohé, chǎngshāng bìxū kāituò hǎiwài xīnxīng shìchǎng lái xúnqiú zēngzhǎng.
example.en: The local smartphone market has reached saturation, forcing manufacturers to explore emerging overseas markets to pursue growth.

meaning: having experienced the vicissitudes of life (idiom)

example.zh: 老人饱经沧桑的面孔上刻满了岁月的痕迹。
example.py: Lǎorén bǎojīng-cāngsāng de miànkǒng shàng kè mǎn le suìyuè de hénjì.
example.en: The old man's weather-beaten face was etched with the marks of time.

example.zh: 电影可以描写暴力,但如果只把血腥场面当作卖点,就会显得空洞。
example.py: Diànyǐng kěyǐ miáoxiě bàolì, dàn rúguǒ zhǐ bǎ xuèxīng chǎngmiàn dàngzuò màidiǎn, jiù huì xiǎnde kōngdòng.

meaning: to conclude a deal, to transact

example.en: Nobody had anticipated beforehand that things would develop to such a serious point.

example.zh: 救援队连夜穿过山区,终于在清晨抵达受灾村庄。
example.py: Jiùyuán duì liányè chuānguò shānqū, zhōngyú zài qīngchén dǐdá shòuzāi cūnzhuāng.
example.en: The rescue team crossed the mountainous area overnight and finally reached the disaster-stricken village at dawn.

example.zh: 受全球需求下降影响,原材料价格连续三个月下跌。
example.py: Shòu quánqiú xūqiú xiàjiàng yǐngxiǎng, yuáncáiliào jiàgé liánxù sān gè yuè xiàdiē.
example.en: Affected by the decline in global demand, raw material prices have fallen for three consecutive months.

example.zh: 面对外来压力,社区居民选择联合起来抵抗不合理的拆迁方案。
example.py: Miànduì wàilái yālì, shèqū jūmín xuǎnzé liánhé qǐlái dǐkàng bù hélǐ de chāiqiān fāng'àn.
example.en: Faced with outside pressure, the community residents chose to unite and resist the unreasonable demolition plan.

meaning: to watch attentively; to fix one's attention on; to stare at; to gaze at

example.zh: 程序员目不转睛地盯着电脑屏幕，仔细排查代码中的隐藏漏洞。
example.py: Chéngxùyuán mùbùzhuǎnjīng de dīng zhe diànnǎo píngmù, zǐxì páichá dàimǎ zhōng de yǐncáng lòudòng.
example.en: The programmer stared fixedly at the computer screen, meticulously searching for hidden bugs in the code.

example.zh: 他定期去医院检查身体。
example.py: tā dìng qī qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá shēn tǐ 。
example.en: He goes to the hospital for regular check-ups.

example.zh: 如果没有先定义核心概念,后面的讨论很容易陷入混乱。
example.py: Rúguǒ méiyǒu xiān dìngyì héxīn gàiniàn, hòumiàn de tǎolùn hěn róngyì xiànrù hùnluàn.
example.en: If the core concepts are not defined first, the later discussion can easily fall into confusion.

meaning: to warn repeatedly; to urge; to exhort again and again

example.zh: 出门前，奶奶反复叮嘱他在路上要注意交通安全。
example.py: Chūmén qián, nǎinai fǎnfù dīngzhǔ tā zài lù shang yào zhùyì jiāotōng ānquán.
example.en: Before he left home, grandma repeatedly reminded him to pay attention to traffic safety on the road.

example.zh: 显然地势必要做些什么。
example.py: xiǎnrán dìshì bìyào zuòxiē shénme 。
example.en: Obviously terrain do what is necessary.

meaning: hostile; malevolence; antagonism; to view as enemy; to stand against

example.zh: 双方应该通过对话增进相互理解，而不是抱有敌视的态度。
example.py: Shuāngfāng yīnggāi tōngguò duìhuà zēngjìn xiānghù lǐjiě, ér bú shì bàoyǒu díshì de tàidù.
example.en: Both sides should enhance mutual understanding through dialogue rather than harboring an attitude of hostility.

example.zh: 犯错并不可耻，不敢承认错误、逃避责任才真正丢人。
example.py: Fàncuò bìng bù kěchǐ, bù gǎn chéngrèn cuòwù, táobì zérèn cái zhēnzhèng diūrén.
example.en: Making a mistake is not disgraceful; it is refusing to admit your mistakes and evading responsibility that is truly embarrassing.

example.zh: 他平时总是丢三落四，今天出门又把钥匙忘在了办公桌上。
example.py: Tā píngshí zǒngshì diūsānlàsì, jīntiān chūmén yòu bǎ yàoshi wàng zài le bàngōngzhuō shang.
example.en: He is always scatterbrained; today when leaving, he once again forgot his keys on his desk.

meaning: to increase by degrees; in increasing order; incremental; progressive

example.zh: 近年来，这家新能源公司的研发投入以每年百分之二十的幅度递增。
example.py: Jìnnián lái, zhè jiā xīn néngyuán gōngsī de yánfā tóurù yǐ měinián bǎifēnzhī'èrshí de fúdù dìzēng.
example.en: In recent years, this new energy company's investment in research and development has increased progressively at an annual rate of 20%.

example.zh: 施工前,专家对隧道沿线的地质条件进行了详细评估。
example.py: Shīgōng qián, zhuānjiā duì suìdào yánxiàn de dìzhì tiáojiàn jìnxíng le xiángxì pínggū.
example.en: Before construction, experts conducted a detailed assessment of the geological conditions along the tunnel route.

meaning: to resist; to boycott; to refuse (to cooperate); to reject; resistance; refusal

example.zh: 我们ACME有限公司，特此宣布，我们将尽我们的力量抵制这种恶意收购。
example.py: wǒmen acme yǒuxiàngōngsī ， tècǐ xuānbù ， wǒmen jiàngjìn wǒmen de lìliang dǐzhì zhèzhǒng èyì shōugòu 。
example.en: We ACME Ltd., hereby declare that we will do our utmost to resist the hostile takeover.

example.zh: 这栋楼在地震后出现裂缝,居民被临时转移到安全地点。
example.py: Zhè dòng lóu zài dìzhèn hòu chūxiàn lièfèng, jūmín bèi línshí zhuǎnyí dào ānquán dìdiǎn.
example.en: This building developed cracks after the earthquake, and the residents were temporarily moved to a safe place.

meaning: unrest (social or political); turmoil; upheaval; commotion

example.zh: 那段动荡的社会历史给普通民众的生活留下了深刻的烙印。
example.py: Nà duàn dòngdàng de shèhuì lìshǐ gěi pǔtōng mínzhòng de shēnghuó liúxià le shēnkè de làoyìn.
example.en: That turbulent period of social history left a profound imprint on the lives of ordinary citizens.

meaning: host; official host (e.g. venue for games or a conference)

example.zh: 作为本届国际峰会的东道主，中国为各国代表提供了周到的服务和保障。
example.py: Zuòwéi běnjiè guójì fēnghuì de dōngdàozhǔ, Zhōngguó wèi gè guó dàibiǎo tígōng le zhōudào de fúwù hé bǎozhàng.
example.en: As the host of this international summit, China provided thoughtful services and support for delegates from all nations.

example.zh: 警方仍在调查嫌疑人的动机,暂时没有公布更多细节。
example.py: Jǐngfāng réng zài diàochá xiányírén de dòngjī, zànshí méiyǒu gōngbù gèng duō xìjié.
example.en: The police are still investigating the suspect’s motive and have not released further details for the time being.

meaning: to freeze (water etc); (fig.) to freeze (assets, prices etc)

example.zh: 法院已依法冻结涉案嫌疑人的全部银行账户和相关资产。
example.py: Fǎyuàn yǐ yīfǎ dòngjié shè'àn xiányírén de quánbù yínháng zhànghù hé xiāngguān zīchǎn.
example.en: The court has legally frozen all bank accounts and related assets belonging to the suspect involved in the case.

meaning: (detectable) movement; (sign of) activity; movement and stillness

example.zh: 房间里一片漆黑，听不到任何动静，似乎屋里根本没有人。
example.py: Fángjiān lǐ yípiàn qīhēi, tīng bú dào rènhé dòngjing, sìhū wū lǐ gēnběn méiyǒu rén.
example.en: The room was pitch black and not a sound could be heard, as if there was nobody inside at all.

example.zh: 清晰的目标能为团队提供持续推进项目的动力。
example.py: Qīngxī de mùbiāo néng wèi tuánduì tígōng chíxù tuījìn xiàngmù de dònglì.
example.en: Clear goals can provide the team with the drive to keep pushing the project forward.

example.zh: 这条贯穿南北的高速铁路被誉为国家经济发展的大动脉。
example.py: Zhè tiáo guànchuān nánběi de gāosù tiělù bèi yù wéi guójiā jīngjì fāzhǎn de dà dòngmài.
example.en: This high-speed railway running north to south is acclaimed as a vital artery of national economic development.

meaning: to go on a journey; to leave

example.zh: 你几时动身去罗马？
example.py: nǐ jǐshí dòngshēn qù luómǎ ？
example.en: When did you leave for Rome?

meaning: chairman of the board of directors

example.zh: 那董事长在公司有点地位，就自以为很了不起。
example.py: nà dǒngshìzhǎng zài gōngsī yǒudiǎn dìwèi ， jiù zìyǐ wéi hěn liǎobuqǐ 。
example.en: That chairman in the company of some importance, has delusions of grandeur.

meaning: to start work, to take action

example.zh: 他动手修好了坏掉的椅子。
example.py: tā dòng shǒu xiū hǎo liǎo huài diào de yǐ zǐ 。
example.en: He fixed the broken chair himself.

example.zh: 我们需要及时掌握市场动态,才能调整采购计划。
example.py: Wǒmen xūyào jíshí zhǎngwò shìchǎng dòngtài, cái néng tiáozhěng cǎigòu jìhuà.
example.en: We need to keep track of market trends in time so that we can adjust the procurement plan.

example.zh: 探险家们在洞穴里发现了骸骨。
example.py: tànxiǎnjiā men zài dòngxué lǐ fāxiàn le háigǔ 。
example.en: Explorers discovered the bones in the cave.

example.zh: 他动员大家参加。
example.py: tā dòng yuán dà jiā cān jiā
example.en: He mobilized everyone to join.

meaning: to look in all directions; to glance around

example.zh: 过马路时要专心观察路况，切忌东张西望或者低头玩手机。
example.py: Guò mǎlù shí yào zhuānxīn guānchá lùkuàng, qièjì dōngzhāngxīwàng huòzhě dītóu wán shǒujī.
example.en: When crossing the street, focus on watching traffic conditions and avoid looking all around or staring down at your phone.

meaning: pocket; bag; to wrap up or hold in a bag; to move in a circle; to canvas or solicit; to take responsibility for; to disclose in detail; combat armor (old)

example.zh: 天气很冷，他把冻僵的双手深深插进外套的大兜里。
example.py: Tiānqì hěn lěng, tā bǎ dòngjiāng de shuāngshǒu shēnshēn chā jìn wàitào de dà dōu lǐ.
example.en: The weather was freezing, so he plunged his stiff hands deep into the large pockets of his coat.

example.zh: 这条通往山顶的小径非常陡峭，登山队员们每走一步都格外谨慎。
example.py: Zhè tiáo tōngwǎng shāndǐng de xiǎojìng fēicháng dǒuqiào, dēngshān duìyuánmen měi zǒu yí bù dōu géwài jǐnshèn.
example.en: The trail leading to the mountain summit is exceptionally steep, and the mountaineers were extra cautious with every step.

example.zh: 这场斗争不仅发生在市场上,也发生在观念层面。
example.py: Zhè chǎng dòuzhēng bùjǐn fāshēng zài shìchǎng shàng, yě fāshēng zài guānniàn céngmiàn.
example.en: This struggle takes place not only in the market, but also at the level of ideas.

example.zh: 服务员端来一壶热茶,请客人在大厅稍等。
example.py: Fúwùyuán duān lái yì hú rèchá, qǐng kèrén zài dàtīng shāo děng.
example.en: The waiter brought over a pot of hot tea and asked the guests to wait in the lobby.

meaning: short in time; fleeting; brief; gasping (breath); curt (tone of voice)

example.zh: 尽管夏令营的时间十分短促，但孩子们在这里结下了深厚的友谊。
example.py: Jǐnguǎn xiàlìngyíng de shíjiān shífēn duǎncù, dàn háizimen zài zhèlǐ jiéxià le shēnhòu de yǒuyì.
example.en: Although the summer camp was very brief, the children forged deep friendships here.

meaning: to conclude; to determine; to come to a judgment

example.zh: 因为他做了不少坏事，我们可以断定他不是个好人。
example.py: yīnwèi tā zuò le bùshǎo huàishì ， wǒmen kěyǐ duàndìng tā bùshì ge hǎorén 。
example.en: Because he has done a lot of bad things, we can conclude that he is not a good man.

meaning: intermittent; off and on; discontinuous; stop-go; stammering; disjointed; inarticulate

example.zh: 雨断断续续地下了一整天。
example.py: yǔ duànduànxùxù dìxià le yīzhěngtiān 。
example.en: Rain off the ground all day.

example.zh: 该国和美国断绝了外交关系。
example.py: gāiguó hé měiguó duànjué le wàijiāoguānxì 。
example.en: The country and the United States broke off diplomatic relations.

meaning: Dragon Boat Festival (5th day of the 5th lunar month)

example.zh: 他和亲属们过端午节。
example.py: tā hé qīn shǔ men guò duān wǔ jié
example.en: He spends Dragon Boat Festival with relatives.

example.zh: 那形状美丽的胸脯，甚至因为太端正太美丽，几乎丧失了性的意味。
example.py: nà xíngzhuàng měilì de xiōngpú ， shènzhì yīnwèi tài duānzhèng tàiměilì ， jīhū sàngshī le xìng de yìwèi 。
example.en: Beautiful breast shape, even too beautiful and too upright, almost lost the meaning of.

example.zh: 他喜欢赌博。
example.py: tā xǐ huan dǔ bó
example.en: He likes gambling.

example.zh: 民主主义是多数选举的独裁。
example.py: mínzhǔzhǔyì shì duōshù xuǎnjǔ de dúcái 。
example.en: Democracy is a dictatorship of the majority vote.

meaning: to supervise and urge completion of a task; to urge on

example.zh: 导师每周都会督促研究生汇报科研进展，确保课题按时完成。
example.py: Dǎoshī měi zhōu dōu huì dūcù yánjiūshēng huìbào kēyán jìnzhǎn, quèbǎo kètí ànshí wánchéng.
example.en: Every week, the advisor urges the graduate students to report on their research progress to ensure the project is completed on schedule.

meaning: countermeasure for dealing with a situation

example.zh: 面对原材料价格上涨的严峻挑战，管理层迅速商讨出了应对的对策。
example.py: Miànduì yuáncáiliào jiàgé shàngzhǎng de yánjùn tiǎozhàn, guǎnlǐcéng xùnsù shāngtǎo chū le yìngduì de duìcè.
example.en: Faced with the severe challenge of rising raw material costs, management swiftly formulated effective countermeasures.

example.zh: 这座建筑的外观完全对称,却并不显得单调。
example.py: Zhè zuò jiànzhù de wàiguān wánquán duìchèn, què bìng bù xiǎnde dāndiào.
example.en: The exterior of this building is completely symmetrical, yet it does not look monotonous.

meaning: to handle; to deal with; to tackle; to get by with; to make do; (dialect) (usu. used in the negative) to get along with (sb)

example.zh: 这个问题不好对付。
example.py: zhè ge wèn tí bù hǎo duì fu
example.en: This problem is hard to handle.

example.zh: 现在日元和人民币的兑换率是多少？
example.py: xiànzài rìyuán hé rénmínbì de duìhuànlǜ shì duōshǎo ？
example.en: Now the Japanese yen and the RMB exchange rate?

meaning: to pile up; to heap; accumulation

example.zh: 连续几个星期的阴雨天气导致港口码头堆积了大量集装箱。
example.py: Liánxù jǐ gè xīngqī de yīnyǔ tiānqì dǎozhì gǎngkǒu mǎtou duījī le dàliàng jízhuāngxiāng.
example.en: Weeks of continuous rainy weather caused a large accumulation of shipping containers at the harbor dock.

example.zh: 面对不公平待遇,员工选择通过法律途径进行对抗。
example.py: Miànduì bù gōngpíng dàiyù, yuángōng xuǎnzé tōngguò fǎlǜ tújìng jìnxíng duìkàng.
example.en: Facing unfair treatment, the employees chose to confront it through legal channels.

meaning: to oppose, to be in opposition

example.zh: 在这个问题上,双方观点明显对立,短期内难以达成一致。
example.py: Zài zhège wèntí shàng, shuāngfāng guāndiǎn míngxiǎn duìlì, duǎnqī nèi nányǐ dáchéng yízhì.
example.en: On this issue, the two sides’ views are clearly opposed, making agreement difficult in the short term.

meaning: rhyming couplet; pair of lines of verse written vertically down the sides of a doorway

example.zh: 每逢除夕，家家户户都会在大门两旁贴上喜庆的红对联以迎新春。
example.py: Měi féng chúxī, jiājiā-hùhù dōu huì zài dàmén liǎngpáng tiē shàng xǐqìng de hóng duìlián yǐ yíng xīnchūn.
example.en: Every Lunar New Year's Eve, families paste festive red couplets on both sides of their front doors to welcome the new spring.

example.zh: 参加比赛的队伍有八支。
example.py: cān jiā bǐ sài de duì wǔ yǒu bā zhī 。
example.en: There are eight teams participating in the competition.

meaning: (of a check etc) to cash; to honor a commitment

example.zh: 作为有担当的企业家，他始终说到做到，认真兑现了对员工的所有承诺。
example.py: Zuòwéi yǒu dāndāng de qǐyèjiā, tā shǐzhōng shuōdào-zuòdào, rènzhēn duìxiàn le duì yuángōng de suǒyǒu chéngnuò.
example.en: As a responsible entrepreneur, he always walks the talk and conscientiously fulfills all promises made to his employees.

example.zh: 表格中的编号必须与合同条款一一对应。
example.py: Biǎogé zhōng de biānhào bìxū yǔ hétong tiáokuǎn yīyī duìyìng.
example.en: The numbers in the table must correspond one by one with the clauses in the contract.

meaning: to contrast; to compare; to place side by side for comparison (as parallel texts); to check

example.zh: 医生对照病人的体检报告和既往病史，做出了准确的诊断。
example.py: Yīshēng duìzhào bìngrén de tǐjiǎn bàogào hé jìwǎng bìngshǐ, zuòchū le zhǔnquè de zhěnduàn.
example.en: The doctor made an accurate diagnosis by comparing the patient's medical checkup report against their past medical history.

example.zh: 学校采取严格的安检措施，坚决杜绝任何危险物品进入校园。
example.py: Xuéxiào cǎiqǔ yángé de ānjiǎn cuòshī, jiānjué dùjué rènhé wēixiǎn wùpǐn jìnrù xiàoyuán.
example.en: The school implemented strict security measures to resolutely prevent any dangerous items from entering the campus.

example.zh: 消息一公布,会议室里顿时安静下来。
example.py: Xiāoxi yì gōngbù, huìyìshì lǐ dùnshí ānjìng xiàlai.
example.en: As soon as the news was announced, the meeting room immediately fell silent.

meaning: to degrade; to degenerate; to become depraved; corrupt; a fall from grace

example.zh: 他曾经是一位优秀青年，后来却因沉迷赌博而逐渐堕落。
example.py: Tā céngjīng shì yí wèi yōuxiù qīngnián, hòulái què yīn chénmí dǔbó ér zhújiàn duòluò.
example.en: He used to be an outstanding young man, but later gradually degenerated due to gambling addiction.

meaning: to tremble; to shiver; uncontrolled shaking of the body

example.zh: 那个小男孩在刺骨的寒风中冻得浑身直哆嗦。
example.py: Nàge xiǎo nánhái zài cìgǔ de hánfēng zhōng dòng de húnshēn zhí duōsuo.
example.en: The little boy shivered all over in the biting cold wind.

example.zh: 随着全球化深入推进，现代社会呈现出更加包容和多元化的文化特征。
example.py: Suízhe quánqiúhuà shēnrù tuījìn, xiàndài shèhuì chéngxiàn chū gèngjiā bāoróng hé duōyuánhuà de wénhuà tèzhēng.
example.en: As globalization deepens, modern society displays more inclusive and diversified cultural characteristics.

example.zh: 毒品是违法的。
example.py: dú pǐn shì wéi fǎ de
example.en: Drugs are illegal.

example.zh: 早高峰时期的交通事故导致市中心主干道严重堵塞达两小时。
example.py: Zǎogāofēng shíqī de jiāotōng shìgù dǎozhì shìzhōngxīn zhǔgàndào yánzhòng dǔsè dá liǎng xiǎoshí.
example.en: A traffic accident during the morning rush hour caused severe congestion on the downtown thoroughfare for two hours.

example.zh: 快节奏的都市生活让许多人渴望重新接近自然。
example.py: Kuài jiézòu de dūshì shēnghuó ràng xǔduō rén kěwàng chóngxīn jiējìn zìrán.
example.en: Fast-paced urban life makes many people long to reconnect with nature.

example.zh: 如果不及时采取治理措施，当地的水质污染状况将会进一步恶化。
example.py: Rúguǒ bù jíshí cǎiqǔ zhìlǐ cuòshī, dāngdì de shuǐzhì wūrǎn zhuàngkuàng jiāng huì jìnyíbù èhuà.
example.en: If remediation measures are not taken in time, the local water pollution situation will worsen further.

meaning: gratitude and grudges; resentment; grudges; grievances

example.zh: 合作双方决定摒弃过往的恩怨，携手开创崭新的合作局面。

example.en: Less luck can not sail.

example.zh: 发言人在面对记者的关键提问时辞令含糊，没有给出任何明确的正面回应。
example.py: Fāyánrén zài miànduì jìzhě de guānjiàn tíwèn shí cílìng hánhu, méiyǒu gěichū rènhé míngquè de zhèngmiàn huíyìng.
example.en: When faced with key questions from reporters, the spokesperson's wording was vague and offered no clear, direct response.

example.zh: 这种罕见疾病发病率很低,因此早期诊断并不容易。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng hǎnjiàn jíbìng fābìnglǜ hěn dī, yīncǐ zǎoqī zhěnduàn bìng bù róngyì.
example.en: The incidence of this rare disease is very low, so early diagnosis is not easy.

meaning: to defend; to uphold; to safeguard

example.zh: 作为一名职业法律工作者，他始终坚定地捍卫法律的尊严与公民的合法权益。
example.py: Zuòwéi yī míng zhíyè fǎlǜ gōngzuòzhě, tā shǐzhōng jiāndìng de hànwèi fǎlǜ de zūnyán yǔ gōngmín de héfǎ quányì.
example.en: As a professional legal practitioner, he has always steadfastly defended the dignity of the law and the legitimate rights and interests of citizens.

meaning: to exchange conventional greetings; to exchange pleasantries

example.zh: 两位多年未见的老友在酒店大堂热情寒暄了几句，随后便一同前往餐厅叙旧。
example.py: Liǎng wèi duō nián wèi jiàn de lǎoyǒu zài jiǔdiàn dàtáng rèqíng hánxuān le jǐ jù, suíhòu biàn yītóng qiánwǎng cāntīng xùjiù.
example.en: The two old friends who had not seen each other for years exchanged warm pleasantries in the hotel lobby and then headed to the restaurant together to reminisce.

example.zh: 这个成语的含义并不难懂,但使用场合很有讲究。
example.py: Zhège chéngyǔ de hányì bìng bù nándǒng, dàn shǐyòng chǎnghé hěn yǒu jiǎngjiu.
example.en: The meaning of this idiom is not hard to understand, but the occasion for using it needs careful attention.

meaning: to waste; to spend; to consume; to squander

example.zh: 编写这部综合性历史巨著耗费了专家学者们整整二十年的光阴与心血。
example.py: Biānxiě zhè bù zōnghéxìng lìshǐ jùzhù hàofèi le zhuānjiā xuézhěmen zhěngzhěng èrshí nián de guāngyīn yǔ xīnxuè.
example.en: Compiling this comprehensive historical masterpiece consumed a full twenty years of time and painstaking effort of the experts and scholars.

example.zh: 这个海边村庄的居民十分好客,常邀请游客到家里喝茶。
example.py: Zhège hǎibiān cūnzhuāng de jūmín shífēn hàokè, cháng yāoqǐng yóukè dào jiā lǐ hē chá.
example.en: The residents of this seaside village are very hospitable and often invite visitors into their homes for tea.

example.zh: 雄伟的交响乐与诗歌交相辉映，展现出战士们奔赴前线时的豪迈气概。
example.py: Xióngwěi de jiāoxiǎngyuè yǔ shīgē jiāoxiāng huìyìng, zhǎnxiàn chū zhànshìmen bēnfù qiánxiàn shí de háomài qìgài.
example.en: The majestic symphony and poetry complemented each other, showcasing the heroic and bold spirit of the soldiers as they marched to the front lines.

example.zh: 这块零件的误差不能超过一毫米,否则整台机器都会受影响。
example.py: Zhè kuài língjiàn de wùchā bù néng chāoguò yì háomǐ, fǒuzé zhěng tái jīqì dū huì shòu yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: The error in this component must not exceed one millimetre, otherwise the whole machine will be affected.

example.zh: 如果决策过程毫无透明度,公众自然难以信任结果。
example.py: Rúguǒ juécè guòchéng háo wú tòumíngdù, gōngzhòng zìrán nányǐ xìnrèn jiéguǒ.
example.en: If the decision-making process has no transparency at all, the public will naturally find it hard to trust the result.

example.zh: 市政府号召市民减少一次性塑料制品的使用。
example.py: Shì zhèngfǔ hàozhào shìmín jiǎnshǎo yícìxìng sùliào zhìpǐn de shǐyòng.
example.en: The city government called on residents to reduce the use of disposable plastic products.

example.zh: 她对谁都很和蔼可亲。
example.py: tā duì shuí dōu hěn héǎikěqīn 。
example.en: To whom she is very amiable.

example.zh: 两个部门合并以后,原有的岗位需要重新调整。
example.py: Liǎng gè bùmén hébìng yǐhòu, yuányǒu de gǎngwèi xūyào chóngxīn tiáozhěng.
example.en: After the two departments merge, the existing posts will need to be readjusted.

example.zh: 科学家正在研究如何利用细菌合成可降解材料。
example.py: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài yánjiū rúhé lìyòng xìjūn héchéng kě jiàngjiě cáiliào.
example.en: Scientists are studying how to use bacteria to synthesise biodegradable materials.

meaning: to accord with; to conform to

example.zh: 一切合乎自然法则。
example.py: yīqiè héhū zìránfǎzé 。
example.en: All in line with the laws of nature.

meaning: to act jointly; to form a partnership

example.zh: 我们达成了合伙协议。
example.py: wǒmen dáchéng le héhuǒ xiéyì 。
example.en: We reached a partnership agreement.

example.zh: 嘿,你先别急着反驳,听我把背景解释完。
example.py: Hēi, nǐ xiān bié jízhe fǎnbó, tīng wǒ bǎ bèijǐng jiěshì wán.
example.en: Hey, do not rush to object; listen to me explain the background first.

meaning: to settle (a dispute out of court); to reconcile; settlement; conciliation; to become reconciled

example.zh: 经过法官多轮耐心的调解工作，双方当事人最终达成和解，化解了长达三年的财产纠纷。
example.py: Jīngguò fǎguān duō lún nàixīn de tiáojiě gōngzuò, shuāngfāng dāngshìrén zuìzhōng dáchéng héjiě, huàjiě le cháng dá sān nián de cáichǎn jiūfēn.
example.en: After multiple rounds of patient mediation by the judge, both parties ultimately reached a settlement, resolving a property dispute that had lasted three years.

example.zh: 邻里之间若能互相包容、守望相助，整个社区的氛围自然会变得非常和睦。
example.py: Línlǐ zhījiān ruò néng hùxiāng bāoróng, shǒuwàngxiāngzhù, zhěnggè shèqū de fēnwéi zìrán huì biànde fēicháng hémù.
example.en: If neighbors can be tolerant of one another and watch out for each other, the atmosphere of the entire community will naturally become very harmonious.

meaning: wishing one could do sth; to hate to be unable; itching to do sth

example.zh: 接到母亲病愈出院的喜讯后，在外求学的他恨不得立刻买票飞回故乡。
example.py: Jiēdào mǔqīn bìngyù chūyuàn de xǐxùn hòu, zàiwài qiúxué de tā hènbu dé lìkè mǎi piào fēi huí gùxiāng.
example.en: Upon receiving the good news that his mother had recovered and was discharged from the hospital, he, studying away from home, was dying to buy a ticket immediately and fly back to his hometown.

meaning: to groan; to snort; to hum; to croon; humph!

example.zh: 面对对手毫无根据的冷嘲热讽，他只是冷哼了一声，根本不予理睬。
example.py: Miànduì duìshǒu háowú gēnjù de lěngcháorèfěng, tā zhǐshì lěng hēng le yī shēng, gēnběn bù yǔ lǐcǎi.
example.en: Facing his opponent's unfounded sarcasm, he merely gave a cold snort and ignored it completely.

example.zh: 雪地上留下了一串清晰的痕迹,警方据此判断嫌疑人的路线。
example.py: Xuědì shàng liúxià le yí chuàn qīngxī de hénjì, jǐngfāng jùcǐ pànduàn xiányírén de lùxiàn.
example.en: A clear trail was left in the snow, and the police used it to judge the suspect’s route.

meaning: callous; heartless; to resolve (to do sth); firm resolve (as in 心)

example.zh: 为了让孩子早日独立生活并适应艰苦环境，父母狠心拒绝了为他继续提供额外资助。
example.py: Wèile ràng háizi zǎorì dúlì shēnghuó bìng shìyìng jiānkǔ huánjìng, fùmǔ hěnxīn jùjué le wèi tā jìxù tígōng éwài zīzhù.
example.en: In order to help their child become independent early and adapt to challenging environments, the parents steeled their hearts and refused to continue providing him with extra financial support.

example.zh: 这家杂货店的老板待人和气，因此吸引了不少老顾客。
example.py: Zhè jiā záhuòdiàn de lǎobǎn dài rén héqi, yīncǐ xīyǐn le bù shǎo lǎo gùkè.
example.en: The grocery store owner treats people amiably, which has attracted many regular customers.

example.zh: 这套西装是根据他的体型量身定做的，穿起来非常合身。
example.py: Zhè tào xīzhuāng shì gēnjù tā de tǐxíng liángshēn dìngzuò de, chuān qǐlai fēicháng héshēn.
example.en: This suit was tailored to his measurements, and it fits him perfectly.

meaning: worthwhile; to be a good deal; to be a bargain; to reckon up; to calculate

example.zh: 如果你每天都要坐地铁上班，买月票会更合算一些。
example.py: Rúguǒ nǐ měitiān dōu yào zuò dìtiě shàngbān, mǎi yuèpiào huì gèng hésuàn yīxiē.
example.en: If you commute by subway every day, buying a monthly pass is much more economical.

example.zh: 一个和谐的社区并不意味着没有分歧,而是人们愿意通过协商解决冲突。
example.py: Yí gè héxié de shèqū bìng bù yìwèizhe méiyǒu fēnqí, ér shì rénmen yuànyì tōngguò xiéshāng jiějué chōngtū.
example.en: A harmonious community does not mean there are no disagreements, but that people are willing to resolve conflicts through consultation.

meaning: roar of laughter (onom.); hubbub; to roar (as a crowd); to deceive; to coax; to amuse (a child)

example.zh: 他的幽默模仿逗得台下的观众哄堂大笑。
example.py: Tā de yōumò mófǎng dòu de táixià de guānzhòng hōngtáng-dàxiào.
example.en: His humorous imitation made the audience burst into hearty laughter.

meaning: to bake; to heat by fire; to set off by contrast

example.zh: 面包房里正在烘烤新出炉的法棍，香气弥漫了整条街。
example.py: Miànbāofáng lǐ zhèngzài hōngkǎo xīn chūlú de fǎgùn, xiāngqì mímàn le zhěng tiáo jiē.
example.en: The bakery was baking fresh baguettes, and the aroma filled the entire street.

example.zh: 过年收到了很多红包。
example.py: guò nián shōu dào liǎo hěn duō hóng bāo 。
example.en: I received a lot of red envelopes during the Chinese New Year.

meaning: to cause a sensation; to create a stir in (a place); commotion; controversy

example.zh: 披头士的发型引起了轰动。
example.py: pītóushì de fàxíng yǐnqǐ le hōngdòng 。
example.en: Beatles hairstyle caused a sensation.

example.zh: 政府正在通过宏观调控手段来稳定房地产市场的健康发展。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài tōngguò hóngguān tiáokòng shǒuduàn lái wěndìng fángdìchǎn shìchǎng de jiànkāng fāzhǎn.
example.en: The government is using macroeconomic control measures to stabilize the healthy development of the real estate market.

example.zh: 连续暴雨引发的洪水淹没了低洼地区,迫使数千户居民转移。
example.py: Liánxù bàoyǔ yǐnfā de hóngshuǐ yānmò le dīwā dìqū, pòshǐ shùqiān hù jūmín zhuǎnyí.
example.en: The flood caused by continuous heavy rain submerged low-lying areas, forcing thousands of households to relocate.

example.zh: 这座依山而建的古老宫殿规模宏伟，气势十分恢宏。
example.py: Zhè zuò yī shān ér jiàn de gǔlǎo gōngdiàn guīmó hóngwěi, qìshì shífēn huīhóng.
example.en: This ancient palace built against the mountain is grand in scale and magnificent in presence.

meaning: to roar; to howl; to shriek; roar or howl of an animal; bellow of rage

example.zh: 狂风在海面上怒吼，掀起了数米高的巨浪。
example.py: Kuángfēng zài hǎimiàn shang nùhǒu, xiānqǐ le shù mǐ gāo de jùlàng.
example.en: The gale roared across the sea, whipping up waves several meters high.

example.zh: 我们今天如何对待自然资源,将直接影响后代的生存条件。
example.py: Wǒmen jīntiān rúhé duìdài zìrán zīyuán, jiāng zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng hòudài de shēngcún tiáojiàn.
example.en: How we treat natural resources today will directly affect the living conditions of future generations.

meaning: fears of trouble in the rear (idiom); family worries (obstructing freedom of action); worries about the future consequences; often in negative expressions, meaning "no worries about anything"

example.zh: 完善的医疗和养老保障体系解决了工人们的后顾之忧。
example.py: Wánshàn de yīliáo hé yǎnglǎo bǎozhàng tǐxì jiějué le gōngrénmen de hòugùzhīyōu.
example.en: A comprehensive medical and pension system eliminated the workers' worries about the future.

example.zh: 我喉咙很干。
example.py: wǒ hóulóng hěn gān 。
example.en: My throat was dry.

example.zh: 运动会能够顺利举行，离不开后勤部门周密细致的保障。
example.py: Yùndònghuì nénggòu shùnlì jǔxíng, lí bù kāi hòuqín bùmén zhōumì xìzhì de bǎozhàng.
example.en: The smooth running of the sports games is inseparable from the meticulous support of the logistics department.

example.zh: 奇怪的是，谁也没有投那候选人一票。
example.py: qíguàideshì ， shuí yě méiyǒu tóu nà hòuxuǎnrén yīpiào 。
example.en: The strange thing is, no one has cast a vote that candidate.

example.zh: 春风吹过，粉红色的樱花花瓣如雪片般纷纷飘落。
example.py: Chūnfēng chuīguò, fěnhóngsè de yīnghuā huābàn rú xuěpiàn bān fēnfēn piāoluò.
example.en: When the spring breeze blew, the pink cherry blossom petals drifted down like snowflakes.

example.zh: 过度使用化肥会导致土壤板结，甚至污染周边地下水。
example.py: Guòdù shǐyòng huàféi huì dǎozhì tǔrǎng bǎnjié, shènzhì wūrǎn zhōubiān dìxiàshuǐ.
example.en: Excessive use of chemical fertilizers can cause soil compaction and even contaminate surrounding groundwater.

example.zh: 政府按照地形和人口密度重新划分了几个行政区域。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ ànzhào dìxíng hé rénkǒu mìdù chóngxīn huàfēn le jǐ gè xíngzhèng qūyù.
example.en: The government redivided several administrative regions according to terrain and population density.

example.zh: 怀孕期间,医生建议她定期检查,并避免服用未经确认的药物。
example.py: Huáiyùn qījiān, yīshēng jiànyì tā dìngqī jiǎnchá, bìng bìmiǎn fúyòng wèijīng quèrèn de yàowù.
example.en: During pregnancy, the doctor advised her to have regular check-ups and avoid taking unconfirmed medicines.

example.zh: 她穿着华丽的丝绸服饰。
example.py: tā chuānzhuó huálì de sīchóu fúshì 。
example.en: She was wearing a gorgeous silk dress.

example.zh: 她说她黄昏之前必须回来。
example.py: tā shuō tā huánghūn zhīqián bìxū huílai 。
example.en: She said she must come back before dusk.

example.zh: 穿过这片寸草不生的荒凉戈壁，才能抵达绿洲城镇。
example.py: Chuānguò zhè piàn cùncǎobùshēng de huāngliáng gēbì, cái néng dǐdá lǜzhōu chéngzhèn.
example.en: Only by crossing this desolate, barren Gobi desert can one reach the oasis town.

meaning: in a great rush; in a flurry

example.zh: 他慌忙跑了出去。
example.py: tā huāng máng pǎo le chū qù
example.en: He rushed out in a hurry.

example.zh: 这种尝试很荒谬。
example.py: zhèzhǒng chángshì hěn huāngmiù 。
example.en: Such an attempt is ridiculous.

meaning: to suddenly realize; to suddenly see the light

example.zh: 听了老师深入浅出的讲解，困惑已久的他终于恍然大悟。
example.py: Tīng le lǎoshī shēnrù-qiǎnchū de jiǎngjiě, kùnhuò yǐ jiǔ de tā zhōngyú huǎngrándàwù.
example.en: After listening to the teacher's accessible explanation, he who had been confused for a long time finally saw the light.

meaning: beyond belief; preposterous; absurd; intemperate; dissipated

example.zh: 多么荒唐的故事！
example.py: duōme huāngtáng de gùshi ！
example.en: What an absurd story!

meaning: to ease (tension); to alleviate; to moderate; to allay; to make more mild

example.zh: 经过多轮艰苦的外交谈判，两国之间的紧张局势终于有所缓和。
example.py: Jīngguò duō lún jiānkǔ de wàijiāo tánpàn, liǎng guó zhījiān de jǐnzhāng júshì zhōngyú yǒu suǒ huǎnhé.
example.en: After several rounds of arduous diplomatic negotiations, the tension between the two countries has finally eased.

example.zh: 这个产品的生产包含多个环节。
example.py: zhè gè chǎn pǐn de shēng chǎn bāo hán duō gè huán jié 。
example.en: The production of this product involves multiple stages.

example.zh: 节日的广场上充满欢乐,连平时严肃的老人也跟着音乐跳了起来。
example.py: Jiérì de guǎngchǎng shàng chōngmǎn huānlè, lián píngshí yánsù de lǎorén yě gēnzhe yīnyuè tiào le qǐlái.
example.en: The festival square was full of joy, and even the usually serious elderly people began dancing along to the music.

meaning: to restore, to return to original state

example.zh: 调查人员根据现场痕迹,还原了事故发生前后的关键过程。
example.py: Diàochá rényuán gēnjù xiànchǎng hénjì, huányuán le shìgù fāshēng qiánhòu de guānjiàn guòchéng.
example.en: Based on the traces at the scene, the investigators reconstructed the key process before and after the accident.

example.zh: 医院为重症患者开设了绿色通道,确保他们能够及时接受治疗。
example.py: Yīyuàn wèi zhòngzhèng huànzhě kāishè le lǜsè tōngdào, quèbǎo tāmen nénggòu jíshí jiēshòu zhìliáo.
example.en: The hospital opened a fast-track channel for critically ill patients to ensure that they could receive treatment in time.

meaning: overseas Chinese; (in a restricted sense) Chinese emigrant who still retains Chinese nationality

example.zh: 许多旅居海外的华侨始终心系祖国，积极支持家乡的教育事业。
example.py: Xǔduō lǚjū hǎiwài de Huáqiáo shǐzhōng xīn xì zǔguó, jījí zhīchí jiāxiāng de jiàoyù shìyè.
example.en: Many overseas Chinese living abroad always care deeply about their homeland and actively support education in their hometowns.

meaning: lit. draw legs on a snake (idiom); fig. to ruin the effect by adding sth superfluous; to overdo it

example.zh: 不要画蛇添足。
example.py: bùyào huàshétiānzú 。
example.en: Do not gild the lily.

example.zh: 这块化石保存了植物叶片的痕迹,对研究古代气候很有价值。
example.py: Zhè kuài huàshí bǎocún le zhíwù yèpiàn de hénjì, duì yánjiū gǔdài qìhòu hěn yǒu jiàzhí.
example.en: This fossil preserves the traces of plant leaves and is very valuable for studying ancient climates.

example.zh: 发言人拿起话筒后,现场的嘈杂声很快安静下来。
example.py: Fāyánrén náqǐ huàtǒng hòu, xiànchǎng de cáozá shēng hěn kuài ānjìng xiàlái.
example.en: After the speaker picked up the microphone, the noise at the scene quickly died down.

meaning: chemical examination; to do a lab test

example.zh: 医生建议他先去化验血液，以便更准确地查明病因。
example.py: Yīshēng jiànyì tā xiān qù huàyàn xuèyè, yǐbiàn gèng zhǔnquè de chámíng bìngyīn.
example.en: The doctor suggested that he first do a blood test to more accurately determine the cause of the illness.

example.zh: 为了让角色更符合朝代背景,演员提前两个小时开始化妆。
example.py: Wèile ràng juésè gèng fúhé cháodài bèijǐng, yǎnyuán tíqián liǎng gè xiǎoshí kāishǐ huàzhuāng.
example.en: To make the character better fit the historical setting, the actor began putting on make-up two hours early.

example.zh: 他把多年积累的经验传授给年轻人,算是对社会的一种回报。

example.py: Xīnrèn xiàozhǎng zài lóngzhòng de jiùzhí yíshì shang fābiǎo yǎnjiǎng, chǎnshù le tā duì wèilái xuéxiào xuéshù fāzhǎn de zhànlüè guīhuà.
example.en: At the grand inauguration ceremony, the newly appointed principal delivered a speech expounding his strategic plan for the university's future academic development.

meaning: to follow the past and herald the future (idiom); part of a historical transition; forming a bridge between earlier and later stages

example.zh: 当代青年肩负着继往开来的历史重任，需要在前人开创的成果基础上勇于开拓创新。
example.py: Dāngdài qīngnián jiānfù zhe jìwǎngkāilái de lìshǐ zhòngrèn, xūyào zài qiánrén kāichuàng de chéngguǒ jīchǔ shang yǒngyú kāituò chuàngxīn.
example.en: Today's youth shoulder the historical mission of carrying forward past traditions while opening up paths for the future, boldly innovating upon the foundation laid by predecessors.

example.zh: 我的耐心到了极限。
example.py: wǒ de nàixīn dào le jíxiàn 。
example.en: My patience to the limit.

example.zh: 春节期间,人们喜欢贴上吉祥的春联,表达对新年的期待。
example.py: Chūnjié qījiān, rénmen xǐhuan tiē shàng jíxiáng de chūnlián, biǎodá duì xīnnián de qīdài.
example.en: During the Spring Festival, people like to put up auspicious couplets to express their hopes for the new year.

example.zh: 这雨没有要停的迹象。
example.py: zhèyǔ méiyǒu yào tíng de jìxiàng 。
example.en: This is not the rain to stop sign.

example.zh: 面对同伴的不解与讥笑，他并未动摇自己的科研设想，而是用严谨的实验结果作出了有力回应。
example.py: Miànduì tóngbàn de bùjiě yǔ jīxiào, tā bìng wèi dòngyáo zìjǐ de kēyán shèxiǎng, ér shì yòng yánjǐn de shíyàn jiéguǒ zuòchū le yǒulì huíyìng.
example.en: In the face of his peers' incomprehension and mockery, he did not waver in his scientific hypothesis, but instead responded powerfully with rigorous experimental results.

example.zh: 这家工厂正在更新机械,以减少能耗并提高生产效率。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhèngzài gēngxīn jīxiè, yǐ jiǎnshǎo nénghào bìng tígāo shēngchǎn xiàolǜ.
example.en: This factory is updating its machinery in order to reduce energy consumption and improve production efficiency.

example.zh: 他天生好记性。
example.py: tā tiānshēng hào jìxing 。
example.en: He was born a good memory.

meaning: minutes; written summary of a meeting

example.zh: 会议结束后，秘书迅速整理出了一份准确详实的会议纪要并分发给所有参会人员。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, mìshū xùnsù zhěnglǐ chū le yī fèn zhǔnquè xiángshí de huìyì jìyào bìng fēnfā gěi suǒyǒu cānhuì rényuán.
example.en: After the meeting concluded, the secretary promptly compiled an accurate and detailed summary of the meeting and distributed it to all attendees.

example.zh: 科学家发现,这种疾病与某些基因变化有关。
example.py: Kēxuéjiā fāxiàn, zhè zhǒng jíbìng yǔ mǒu xiē jīyīn biànhuà yǒuguān.
example.en: Scientists found that this disease is related to changes in certain genes.

example.zh: 经济转型给小城市带来了新的发展机遇。
example.py: Jīngjì zhuǎnxíng gěi xiǎo chéngshì dàilái le xīn de fāzhǎn jīyù.
example.en: Economic transformation has brought new development opportunities to small cities.

example.zh: 学校应当给予贫困学生更多支持,而不是只强调成绩排名。
example.py: Xuéxiào yīngdāng jǐyǔ pínkùn xuéshēng gèng duō zhīchí, ér bú shì zhǐ qiángdiào chéngjì páimíng.
example.en: Schools should give disadvantaged students more support, rather than emphasising only grade rankings.

meaning: anxious for quick results (idiom); to demand instant success; impatient for result; impetuous

example.zh: 学习一门新语言是一个循序渐进的过程，急于求成往往会导致基础薄弱、欲速不达。
example.py: Xuéxí yī mén xīn yǔyán shì yī gè xúnxù-jiànjìn de guòchéng, jíyúqiúchéng wǎngwǎng huì dǎozhì jīchǔ bóruò, yùsù-bùdá.
example.en: Learning a new language is a step-by-step process; being impatient for quick results often leads to weak fundamentals and the opposite of what one desires.

example.zh: 这本书记载了很多历史事件。
example.py: zhè běn shū jì zài liǎo hěn duō lì shǐ shì jiàn 。
example.en: This book records many historical events.

meaning: at the earliest possible time; as soon as possible

example.zh: 尽可能及早拜访您。
example.py: jìn kěnéng jízǎo bàifǎng nín 。
example.en: Visit you as soon as possible.

example.zh: 在处理复杂的客户投诉时，客服人员必须保持耐心与冷静，切忌产生急躁情绪。
example.py: Zài chǔlǐ fùzá de kèhù tóusù shí, kèfú rényuán bìxū bǎochí nàixīn yǔ lěngjìng, qièjì chǎnshēng jízào qíngxù.
example.en: When handling complex customer complaints, customer service representatives must maintain patience and composure, avoiding any impatience or irritability.

example.zh: 面对突如其来的舞台突发状况，主持人机智幽默地巧妙圆场，赢得了观众阵阵掌声。
example.py: Miànduì tūrúqílái de wǔtái tūfā zhuàngkuàng, zhǔchírén jīzhì yōumò de qiǎomiào yuánchǎng, yíngdé le guānzhòng zhènzhèn zhǎngshēng.
example.en: Facing an unexpected mishap on stage, the host tactfully and humorously smoothed things over, winning rounds of applause from the audience.

meaning: to roll, to curl; roll; measure word for rolls

example.zh: 她把海报卷起来,放进纸筒里带走。
example.py: Tā bǎ hǎibào juǎn qǐlái, fàng jìn zhǐtǒng lǐ dài zǒu.
example.en: She rolled up the poster and put it into a paper tube to take away.

example.zh: 这套小说一共有三卷,内容围绕同一个家族展开。
example.py: Zhè tào xiǎoshuō yí gòng yǒu sān juàn, nèiróng wéirào tóng yí gè jiāzú zhǎnkāi.
example.en: This set of novels has three volumes in total, with the content centred on the same family.

example.zh: 这个剧本虽然情节简单,却把人物关系写得很细腻。
example.py: Zhège jùběn suīrán qíngjié jiǎndān, què bǎ rénwù guānxì xiě de hěn xìnì.
example.en: Although this script has a simple plot, it portrays the relationships between the characters very delicately.

example.zh: 气象部门预报显示，虽然全市整体天气晴好，但午后局部地区仍可能出现短时雷阵雨。
example.py: Qìxiàng bùmén yùbào xiǎnshì, suīrán quán shì zhěngtǐ tiānqì qínghǎo, dàn wǔhòu júbù dìqū réng kěnéng chūxiàn duǎnshí léizhènyǔ.
example.en: Meteorological forecasts indicate that while the city overall will enjoy clear weather, local areas may still experience brief thundershowers in the afternoon.

example.zh: 他突然辞职的举动让整个团队都感到意外。
example.py: Tā tūrán cízhí de jǔdòng ràng zhěnggè tuánduì dōu gǎndào yìwài.
example.en: His sudden move to resign made the whole team feel surprised.

example.zh: 重大项目启动前,管理层必须进行充分的决策讨论。
example.py: Zhòngdà xiàngmù qǐdòng qián, guǎnlǐcéng bìxū jìnxíng chōngfèn de juécè tǎolùn.
example.en: Before a major project starts, management must hold thorough decision-making discussions.

example.zh: 多次求助无果后,他一度感到绝望。
example.py: Duō cì qiúzhù wú guǒ hòu, tā yí dù gǎndào juéwàng.
example.en: After seeking help many times without success, he once felt despair.

meaning: to come to understand; to realize; consciousness; awareness; Buddhist enlightenment (Sanskrit: cittotpāda)

example.zh: 他很有觉悟。
example.py: tā hěn yǒu jué wù
example.en: He is highly aware.

meaning: to awaken; to come to realize; awakened to the truth; the truth dawns upon one; scales fall from the eyes; to become aware

example.zh: 中国是一只沉睡的狮子，一旦觉醒，将会震惊世界。
example.py: zhōngguó shì yīzhī chénshuì de shīzi ， yīdàn juéxǐng ， jiānghuì zhènjīng shìjiè 。
example.en: China is a sleeping lion, once awakening, will shock the world.

example.zh: 在日本，遇到人鞠躬是有礼貌的表现。
example.py: zài rìběn ， yùdào rén jūgōng shì yǒu lǐmào de biǎoxiàn 。
example.en: In Japan, meet people bow is good manners.

example.zh: 大家都在聚精会神地听着。
example.py: dàjiā dōu zài jùjīnghuìshén dì tīng zhe 。
example.en: Everyone listened attentively.

example.zh: 这篇散文字句优美、意蕴深远，值得读者静下心来反复咀嚼与品味。
example.py: Zhè piān sǎnwén zìjù yōuměi, yìyùn shēnyuǎn, zhídé dúzhě jìng xià xīn lái fǎnfù jǔjué yǔ pǐnwèi.
example.en: With its beautiful phrasing and profound meaning, this essay is worthy of readers calming their minds to repeatedly mull over and savor.

example.zh: 地震发生时,整栋楼都在剧烈摇晃。
example.py: Dìzhèn fāshēng shí, zhěng dòng lóu dōu zài jùliè yáohuàng.
example.en: When the earthquake occurred, the whole building was shaking violently.

meaning: to detain (a prisoner); to keep sb in custody

example.zh: 因严重扰乱公共交通秩序并拒不听从劝阻，当事人被公安机关依法处以行政拘留十天。
example.py: Yīn yánzhòng rǎoluàn gōnggòng jiāotōng zhìxù bìng jùbù tīngcóng quànzǔ, dāngshìrén bèi gōng'ān jīguān yīfǎ chǔyǐ xíngzhèng jūliú shí tiān.
example.en: For seriously disrupting public transportation order and refusing to heed warnings, the person involved was legally placed in administrative detention for ten days by public security authorities.

example.zh: 谈判进入关键阶段,双方都不愿意让局面失控。
example.py: Tánpàn jìnrù guānjiàn jiēduàn, shuāngfāng dōu bú yuànyì ràng júmiàn shīkòng.
example.en: The negotiations have entered a critical stage, and neither side wants the situation to get out of control.

example.zh: 军队迅速展开救援,确保道路恢复通行。
example.py: Jūnduì xùnsù zhǎnkāi jiùyuán, quèbǎo dàolù huīfù tōngxíng.
example.en: The army quickly launched a rescue operation to ensure the roads were reopened.

example.zh: 尽管面试再次失利让他感到十分沮丧，但他很快重拾信心，开始认真复盘准备下一次机会。
example.py: Jǐnguǎn miànshì zàicì shīlì ràng tā gǎndào shífēn jǔsàng, dàn tā hěn kuài chóngshí xìnxīn, kāishǐ rènzhēn fùpán zhǔnbèi xià yī cì jīhuì.
example.en: Although failing the interview once again made him feel very dejected, he quickly regained confidence and began carefully reviewing his performance to prepare for the next opportunity.

example.zh: 我会控制住局势。
example.py: wǒhuì kòngzhì zhù júshì 。
example.en: I will control the situation.

example.zh: 雄伟的万里长城蜿蜒盘旋于崇山峻岭之间，是一处举世闻名的中国历史文化古迹。
example.py: Xióngwěi de Wànlǐ Chángchéng wānyán pánxuán yú chóngshān-jùnlǐng zhījiān, shì yī chù jǔshì-wénmíng de Zhōngguó lìshǐ wénhuà gǔjì.
example.en: The majestic Great Wall winds through steep mountains and ridges, standing as a world-famous Chinese historical and cultural monument.

example.zh: 经过数十年的快速发展，中国在脱贫攻坚和科技创新领域取得了举世瞩目的巨大成就。
example.py: Jīngguò shù shí nián de kuàisù fāzhǎn, Zhōngguó zài tuōpín gōngjiān hé kējì chuàngxīn lǐngyù qǔdé le jǔshì-zhǔmù de jùdà chéngjiù.
example.en: After decades of rapid development, China has achieved tremendous accomplishments that have attracted worldwide attention in poverty alleviation and technological innovation.

meaning: to restrict; to restrain; constrained; awkward; ill at ease; uncomfortable; reticent

example.zh: 初次来到陌生人的家庭聚会，性格腼腆的他显得有些局促和拘束。
example.py: Chūcì láidào mòshēngrén de jiātíng jùhuì, xìnggé miǎntiǎn de tā xiǎnde yǒuxiē júcù hé jūshù.
example.en: Attending a family gathering of strangers for the first time, he felt somewhat awkward and ill at ease due to his shy personality.

meaning: according to reports; it is reported (that)

example.zh: 据悉，这条连接两座重要省会城市的高速铁路将于今年年底正式开通运营。
example.py: Jùxī, zhè tiáo liánjiē liǎng zuò zhòngyào shěnghuì chéngshì de gāosù tiělù jiāng yú jīnnián niándǐ zhèngshì kāitōng yùnyíng.
example.en: According to reports, this high-speed railway connecting two major provincial capitals will officially begin operation by the end of this year.

example.zh: 这项研究局限于小样本数据,还需要进一步验证。
example.py: Zhè xiàng yánjiū júxiàn yú xiǎo yàngběn shùjù, hái xūyào jìnyíbù yànzhèng.
example.en: This study is limited to small-sample data and still needs further verification.

example.zh: 他在北京居住了十年。
example.py: tā zài běi jīng jū zhù liǎo shí nián 。
example.en: He lived in Beijing for ten years.

meaning: to play a critical role; influential

example.zh: 作为核心零部件的独家供应商，该企业在全球半导体产业链中占据着举足轻重的战略地位。
example.py: Zuòwéi héxīn língbùjiàn de dújiā gōngyìngshāng, gāi qǐyè zài quánqiú bàndǎotǐ chǎnyèliàn zhōng zhànjù zhe jǔzú-qīngzhòng de zhànlüè dìwèi.
example.en: As an exclusive supplier of core components, this enterprise occupies a pivotal strategic position in the global semiconductor industry chain.

meaning: to extract (ore or other resource from a mine); to exploit; to mine

example.zh: 为了保护当地脆弱的生态环境，政府决定严厉限制在该保护区内开采煤炭。
example.py: Wèile bǎohù dāngdì cuìruò de shēngtài huánjìng, zhèngfǔ juédìng yánlì xiànzhì zài gāi bǎohùqū nèi kāicǎi méitàn.
example.en: In order to protect the fragile local ecological environment, the government decided to strictly restrict coal mining in the protected area.

meaning: to expel (a member of an organization); to fire (an employee)

example.zh: 我们决定不开除你。
example.py: wǒmen juédìng bù kāichú nǐ 。
example.en: We decided not to fire you.

example.zh: 站在山顶俯瞰，眼前是一片开阔的平原与奔流不息的江河。
example.py: Zhàn zài shāndǐng fǔkàn, yǎnqián shì yípiàn kāikuò de píngyuán yǔ bēnliú bùxī de jiānghé.
example.en: Standing on the mountaintop looking down, before our eyes was a wide, expansive plain and an endlessly flowing river.

meaning: spacious and well-lit; open and clear; (of character) optimistic; cheerful; carefree

example.zh: 她性格热情开朗，无论遇到什么困难总能用乐观的心态去面对。
example.py: Tā xìnggé rèqíng kāilǎng, wúlùn yùdào shénme kùnnan zǒng néng yòng lèguān de xīntài qù miànduì.
example.en: She has a warm and cheerful personality, and she always faces difficulties with an optimistic attitude.

example.zh: 这位父亲思想非常开明，始终尊重并支持女儿自由选择未来的职业发展。
example.py: Zhè wèi fùqīn sīxiǎng fēicháng kāimíng, shǐzhōng zūnzhòng bìng zhīchí nǚ'ér zìyóu xuǎnzé wèilái de zhíyè fāzhǎn.
example.en: The father is very open-minded, always respecting and supporting his daughter's freedom in choosing her future career path.

meaning: to open up; to set up; to establish

example.zh: 这家创新型科技公司在激烈的市场竞争中开辟了一条全新的发展路径。
example.py: Zhè jiā chuàngxīn xíng kējì gōngsī zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng kāipì le yì tiáo quánxīn de fāzhǎn lùjìng.
example.en: This innovative tech company carved out a brand-new development path amidst fierce market competition.

example.zh: 天太冷了，她烧了一壶开水。
example.py: tiān tài lěng liǎo ， tā shāo liǎo yī hú kāi shuǐ 。
example.en: It was too cold, so she boiled a kettle of water.

meaning: to break new ground (for agriculture); to open up (a new seam); to develop (border regions); fig. to open up (new horizons)

example.zh: 年轻的时候你应该开拓你的思想。
example.py: niánqīng de shíhou nǐ yīnggāi kāituò nǐ de sīxiǎng 。
example.en: Young you should open up your mind.

example.zh: 这座城市正在大力开展环保活动。
example.py: zhè zuò chéng shì zhèng zài dà lì kāi zhǎn huán bǎo huó dòng 。
example.en: The city is vigorously carrying out environmental protection activities.

meaning: expenditures; expenses; to spend money; (coll.) to pay wages

example.zh: 我这个月要减少开支。
example.py: wǒ zhège yuè yào jiǎnshǎo kāizhī 。
example.en: This month I want to reduce expenses.

example.zh: 我们应该理性看待技术进步带来的风险和机会。
example.py: Wǒmen yīnggāi lǐxìng kàndài jìshù jìnbù dài lái de fēngxiǎn hé jīhuì.
example.en: We should view the risks and opportunities brought by technological progress rationally.

meaning: to carry a story; to publish (in a newspaper or magazine)

example.zh: 我在报纸上刊登了我的房子的广告。
example.py: wǒ zài bàozhǐ shàng kāndēng le wǒ de fángzi de guǎnggào 。
example.en: I published my house ad in the newspaper.

example.zh: 大自然很慷慨。
example.py: dàzìrán hěn kāngkǎi 。
example.en: Nature is very generous.

meaning: to explore; to survey; to prospect (for oil etc); prospecting

example.zh: 地质考察队深入戈壁沙漠进行长期勘探，终于发现了一处大型油气田。
example.py: Dìzhì kǎochá duì shēnrù gēbì shāmò jìnxíng chángqī kāntàn, zhōngyú fāxiàn le yí chù dàxíng yóuqìtián.
example.en: The geological expedition ventured deep into the Gobi Desert for prolonged exploration and finally discovered a large oil and gas field.

example.zh: 他去医院看望了生病的朋友。
example.py: tā qù yī yuàn kàn wàng liǎo shēng bìng de péng yǒu 。
example.en: He went to the hospital to visit his sick friend.

example.zh: 这篇学术论文经过同行严谨的审稿后，成功发表在国际知名学术刊物上。
example.py: Zhè piān xuéshù lùnwén jīngguò tóngháng yánjǐn de shěngǎo hòu, chénggōng fābiǎo zài guójì zhīmíng xuéshù kānwù shang.
example.en: After rigorous peer review, this academic paper was successfully published in an internationally renowned scholarly publication.

example.zh: 代表团将前往沿海城市,考察当地的港口建设。
example.py: Dàibiǎotuán jiāng qiánwǎng yánhǎi chéngshì, kǎochá dāngdì de gǎngkǒu jiànshè.
example.en: The delegation will go to coastal cities to inspect the local port construction.

example.zh: 这支考古队在沙漠边缘发现了古代城市遗址。
example.py: Zhè zhī kǎogǔ duì zài shāmò biānyuán fāxiàn le gǔdài chéngshì yízhǐ.
example.en: This archaeological team discovered the ruins of an ancient city on the edge of the desert.

example.zh: 年底考核不仅看业绩,也会看团队合作能力。
example.py: Niándǐ kǎohé bùjǐn kàn yèjì, yě huì kàn tuánduì hézuò nénglì.
example.en: The year-end assessment looks not only at performance, but also at teamwork ability.

example.zh: 随着船只缓缓向码头靠拢，岸上的迎接人群纷纷挥手致意。
example.py: Suízhe chuánzhī huǎnhuǎn xiàng mǎtou kàolǒng, àn shang de yíngjiē rénqún fēnfēn huīshǒu zhìyì.

example.py: Xiāochú pínkùn hé bǎohù shēngtài huánjìng shì yí xiàng chángqī de xìtǒng gōngchéng, kěwèi rènzhòng dàoyuǎn.
example.en: Eradicating poverty and protecting the ecological environment is a long-term systematic endeavor; the burden is indeed heavy and the road long.

meaning: daily renewal, monthly change; every day sees new developments; rapid progress

example.zh: 现代信息技术发展日新月异，深刻改变了人们的生活方式。
example.py: Xiàndài xìnxī jìshù fāzhǎn rìxīn yuèyì, shēnkè gǎibiànle rénmen de shēnghuó fāngshì.
example.en: Modern information technology is advancing rapidly with each passing day, profoundly changing people's ways of life.

example.zh: 随着能源价格上涨,企业对节能技术的需求日益迫切。
example.py: Suízhe néngyuán jiàgé shàngzhǎng, qǐyè duì jiénéng jìshù de xūqiú rìyì pòqiè.
example.en: As energy prices rise, companies’ need for energy-saving technology is increasingly urgent.

example.zh: 将少量的食盐放入温水中搅拌，很快就会完全溶解。
example.py: Jiāng shǎoliàng de shíyán fàngrù wēnshuǐ zhōng jiǎobàn, hěn kuài jiù huì wánquán róngjiě.
example.en: Put a small amount of table salt into warm water and stir; it will quickly dissolve completely.

meaning: one's appearance; one's aspect; looks; features

example.zh: 他的容貌改变了许多。
example.py: tā de róngmào gǎibiàn le xǔduō 。
example.en: His appearance has changed a lot.

meaning: to hold; to contain; to accommodate; to tolerate (different opinions)

example.zh: 这家酒店可以容纳一千人。
example.py: zhèjiā jiǔdiàn kěyǐ róngnà yīqiān rén 。
example.en: The hotel can accommodate a thousand people.

example.zh: 请将实验剩余的化学试剂密封存放在专用的玻璃容器中。
example.py: Qǐng jiāng shíyàn shèngyú de huàxué shìjì mìfēng cúnfàng zài zhuānyòng de bōli róngqì zhōng.
example.en: Please seal and store the surplus chemical reagents from the experiment in dedicated glass containers.

meaning: harmonious; friendly relations; on good terms with one another

example.zh: 我与我的弟弟相处融洽。
example.py: wǒ yǔ wǒ de dìdi xiāngchǔ róngqià 。
example.en: I get along with my brother.

example.py: wǒ wúfǎ róngrěn tā de xíngwéi 。
example.en: I could not tolerate her behavior.

meaning: to knead; to massage; to rub

example.py: Tā cháng shíjiān dīngzhe diànnǎo píngmù, gǎndào shuāngyǎn suāntòng, biàn bìshang yǎnjing qīngqīng róule rou tàiyángxué.
example.en: Having stared at the computer screen for a long time, his eyes felt sore, so he closed his eyes and gently rubbed his temples.

example.zh: 卧室里安装了暖光灯，柔和的光线让人感到十分放松。

example.zh: 这份报告直接指出了公司管理机制中的弱点。
example.py: Zhè fèn bàogào zhíjiē zhǐchū le gōngsī guǎnlǐ jīzhì zhōng de ruòdiǎn.
example.en: This report directly pointed out the weaknesses in the company’s management mechanism.

meaning: a certain number or amount; how many?; how much?

example.en: The experts put forward several suggestions for amending this plan.

example.zh: 做人应该讲究诚信，绝不能故意撒谎。
example.py: Zuòrén yīnggāi jiǎngjiu chéngxìn, jué bù néng gùyì sāhuǎng.

example.zh: 外面天气很冷，她的双腮被冻得通红。

example.zh: 他在事故中丧失了部分听力,但仍坚持工作。

meaning: to bring sth to sb; to deliver

example.zh: 这项改革涉及教育、医疗和住房等多个领域。

meaning: to report (to the authorities); to declare (to customs)

example.en: The court reviewed the lawsuit.

example.zh: 动物要适应环境才能生存下去。

example.en: Spring has arrived, all things are reviving, and the earth is full of vitality everywhere.

example.zh: 谎言像一朵盛开的鲜花，外表美丽，生命短暂。
example.py: huǎngyán xiàng yīduǒ shèngkāi de xiānhuā ， wàibiǎoměilì ， shēngmìng duǎnzàn 。

meaning: to state; to declare; statement; declaration

example.zh: 面对主人的盛情款待，客人们感到十分温暖和感激。
example.py: Miànduì zhǔrén de shèngqíng kuǎndài, kèrénmen gǎndào shífēn wēnnuǎn hé gǎnjī.

meaning: fame and power; prestige; influence; impetus; momentum

meaning: unfamiliar; strange; out of practice; not accustomed

example.py: Guòdù kāifā huì pòhuài dāngdì shēngtài, yǐngxiǎng chángqī fāzhǎn.

example.zh: 学生们学习了基本的生物知识。
example.py: xué shēng mén xué xí liǎo jī běn de shēng wù zhī shí 。

example.py: chǒuwén ràng tā fùchū le shīqù shēngyù de dàijià 。
example.en: Scandal cost him his lost reputation.

example.zh: “失败是成功之母”一直是他激励自己不断前行的座右铭。
example.py: “Shībài shì chénggōng zhī mǔ” yìzhí shì tā jīlì zìjǐ búduàn qiánxíng de zuòyòumíng.
example.en: "Failure is the mother of success" has always been his motto inspiring him to forge ahead continuously.

example.zh: 这种事情必须由你自己做主，别人只能提供建议。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng shìqing bìxū yóu nǐ zìjǐ zuòzhǔ, biérén zhǐ néng tígōng jiànyì.
example.en: You must make the decision for yourself in this kind of matter; others can only offer advice.

example.zh: 这些数据足以证明市场需求正在发生变化。
example.py: Zhèxiē shùjù zúyǐ zhèngmíng shìchǎng xūqiú zhèngzài fāshēng biànhuà.
example.en: These data are sufficient to prove that market demand is changing.
